facts.readiness: ready 42, 44; not ready 43 (0 closure fires in every arm), 45 (S050/S030 K_LONG arms 1 fire < 5), 46 (K_LONG arms 2 fires < 5). Seed 43's reset-flag checks read false only because no fire occurred (vacuous), not a flag defect.
facts.why_not_ready: latch-dominated seeds: E3 re-selected (fresh dACC forward) on only 138 / 281-322 / 300-301 of 1200 env steps (seeds 43/45/46; latched 73-89%) vs 1160-1184 on 42/44 (latched 1-3%). The lateral-PFC rule_state and the closure detector are both denominated on FRESH ticks, and rule_delta follows the SAME decay curve on every seed (red-team recompute: median rule_delta by fresh-tick index is indistinguishable across 42/43/45/46), crossing the stability point at ~77-100 fresh ticks. Seed 43 has exactly 23 fresh ticks in every 200-step life (23 x 6 = 138), so it is cut off at index 22 and never stabilises (all 132 closure evaluations not_stable_yet(0/6)); seeds 45/46 fired only in the one or two lives that exceeded ~80-100 fresh ticks. The fixed 23-per-200 periodicity points at a fixed-length commitment hold (MECH-090 held-action stepping) rather than a stochastic latch.
facts.C1_per_ready_seed: occ_ip_argmax(S050_KS_ON) - occ_ip_argmax(S050_KS_OFF): seed 42 0.937-0.761 = 0.176; seed 44 1.000-1.000 = 0.000. Mean 0.088 vs margin max(2 x pstdev 0.088, 0.10) = 0.176 -> not met
facts.headroom: gate green 4/5, but counted over ALL seeds that ran: S050_KS_OFF release 0.239 (42), 0.790 (43), 0.000 (44), 0.861 (45), 0.867 (46). Among READY seeds only 1/2 has headroom (seed 44: pe_unsat p50 5.61 x floor 0.25 = 1.40 > ~1.0 critical, so nothing can release). The all-seeds denominator was a deliberate red-team F1 choice at authoring (driver line ~696: 'intended n, all seeds that ran, not only ready ones'); this autopsy's point is that it therefore cannot certify headroom on the seeds C1 is scored on.

four_layer_diagnosis.biological_reference: clear -- dACC outcome/error signals adapt under repeated identical outcomes and the outcome signal fades in exploitation periods (Quilodran, Rothe & Procyk 2008; Behrens 2007; Shenhav 2013/2016; targeted_review_connectome_mech_268, 6 entries). The failure is not a biology mismatch; it is the operating regime of the trained agent.
